revisions_applied_details.issue: Title mismatch between visual design and slide content
revisions_applied_details.action_taken: Used the shorter, aligned version '世界レベルの才能、しかし孤立' as the main slide title. The fuller statement is preserved in speaker notes.

revisions_applied_details.issue: Failed 'So What?' test - slide was organization-centric, not audience-centric
revisions_applied_details.action_taken: Reframed the action title to 'あなたのスキルが、今、世界から求められている' and rewrote key points to emphasize how the AUDIENCE's skills are valuable (e.g., 'あなたの検証技術が...', 'あなたの暗号研究が...', 'あなたの分析能力が...').
Added '「私自身も、かつては孤立した研究者だった」' as a visible quote on the slide, and expanded speaker notes to include the full founder journey story (from isolated master's student to founding Nyx Foundation).

revisions_applied_details.issue: Lacked visual bookend with Slide 3 (Toyama story)
revisions_applied_details.action_taken: Created a before/after visual concept showing '🧑‍💻 富山、一人' → '👥🌐👥 世界とつながる' to create a visual callback to the Toyama engineer story and close the emotional loop.

revisions_applied_details.issue: CTA was generic without specific commitment
revisions_applied_details.action_taken: Added specific, tangible promise: '📋 今週中に、助成金リストを共有します' (This week, we'll share the grant list with you).
